overviewHtml:
Vulnerabilities reported per process create floods of duplicate tickets, which teams struggle to work through.

What you get

  • A trigger every 30 minutes that queries open vulnerabilities in security.events
  • Grouping by product using release monitoring
  • A sub-workflow that checks for an existing Jira ticket
  • Owner lookup and ticket creation with a tracking link back to Dynatrace
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows and Runtime Vulnerability Analytics
  • Release monitoring (product and version information) for your processes
  • Jira for Workflows with a connection
  • Ownership teams on your entities
setupHtml:
1. In Workflows, choose Upload and import the sub-workflow appsec-ticket-creation-sub-workflow.workflow-template.yaml first. Assign the Jira connection.
  2. Copy the new sub-workflow's ID.
  3. Import appsec-trigger.workflow-template.yaml and replace `` with that ID.
  4. Run the trigger once manually, then activate the schedule.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows, Runtime Vulnerability Analytics, release monitoring and a Jira connection.

  1. Import the ticket creation sub-workflow and assign Jira
  2. Import the trigger and point it at the sub-workflow
  3. Run once, then activate the schedule
